A fetch that never resolves within AGENT_MEMORY_SEMANTIC_BUDGET_MS=5: 'timeout'.
A confident hit whose file maps outside the memory root: 'unmapped'.
A confident mapped hit that fails clearsAutomaticGate: 'lexical_gate'.
A confident hit that passes: provenance lane 'semantic' or 'hybrid' and semanticStatus 'used'.
criteria.test_id: 1573:1573-A-semantic-degradation-observability:6 records used on a trusted semantic hit
